newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean yields end flat on central bank supply.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean yields end flat on central bank supply.

text.p: Yields on three-year benchmark corporate bonds and three-month certificates of deposit closed flat on Monday as the central bank's fund supply eased the strain brought on by the Kia Group's financial troubles, brokers said.
The central bank supplied 700 billion won to the banking system through two-day repurchase agreements (Repos).
* 3-yr corporates close unchanged at 12.13 from Saturday
* Overnight average call rates at 11.55 vs 11.59
"There are still uncertainties in the money market which could push the yields up to 12.20 percent," he said.
Traders expected slow trading on Tuesday as banks are likely to be busy meeting the won reserve requirement.
